step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates a zero-downtime deployment strategy used by WAG Labs. Incoming public traffic enters through an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB routes traffic to an HAProxy cluster (a self-managed proxy). HAProxy periodically queries AWS Route 53 to resolve CNAME endpoints determining active production and canary target destinations. Traffic is then conditionally routed to the Blue Cluster (existing live EC2 instances) or shifted gradually (e.g., 10% canary) to the Green Cluster (new EC2 deployment instances).
